name: truing_proto
description: SPEC §12 wire protocol: JSON frames for telemetry events, the required current-state query, GET_CURRENT_CYCLE_PROVENANCE, and inbound operator commands. Transport-independent by design (SPEC §12.1: only the transport changes, the frontend does not), so the same frames serve WiFi, the USB CDC fallback and host tests. Enforces the §12.3 wait_id wire contract; admissibility remains the orchestrator's.
